fieldNotes.truckGate: Open driveway off Skyview Dr into front lot, then an open paved curve around the NE corner into the east dock apron. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at the road or at the yard transition (verified in 2025-03 Street View and z20 satellite).

fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank along the full ~600 ft east wall with ~25-30 reefer trailers backed in; total door count estimated ~40 (band 25-50) from z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: All trailers are backed into dock doors (active); no separately marked bobtail/drop-trailer stalls visible, so dropArea NONE.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Single east dock apron runs the building length and can hold a 3+ truck queue along the dock face.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial corridor off I-20 in Lithia Springs/Douglasville, woods and a retention pond bordering the site; judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 2120 Skyview Dr (geocoded to Lithia Springs/Douglasville GA 30122; supplied coords were ~2.5 km west in a residential area and were wrong). Building front carries the painted '2120' address number, verified in Street View.

sites.name: Home Chef Manufacturing & Distribution Center Baltimore MD
sites.dossierExcerpt:
The supplied pin (39.230308, -76.577486) landed directly on the target. Web
research confirms 1701 E Patapsco Ave is the Harbor Logistics Center, a
~96-acre Curtis Bay industrial development with three matching warehouse
buildings; Home Chef leases ~150-170k sq ft (its largest plant by volume, first
East Coast site, opened 2023). Satellite imagery shows exactly three large
white-roof warehouses by the Patapsco River next to oil-storage tanks. The pin
sits on the center/west building, which carries the "1701" placard on its
north office face (confirmed in Street View) and has the full dock + trailer
layout consistent with a manufacturing/distribution plant. That building is the
one geofenced; the other two parcels are excluded.

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus-style entrance off E Patapsco Ave; Street View (2024-06) shows no barrier arm, swing/sliding gate, or pinch-point across the truck drive. Shared Harbor Logistics Center park, no perimeter fence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance in Street View or satellite.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved aprons and an uncontrolled multi-lane park drive leave ample room to add a controlled bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Long marked trailer-drop row (~30 stalls) along the SW (river) perimeter drive, plus apron parking; counted from z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~35 doors along the building's SW face with trailers backed in; overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Home Chef leases one of three matching warehouses in the Harbor Logistics Center; only the Home Chef building (center/west) is geofenced here.
fieldNotes.railServed: CSX/rail lines run west across the Patapsco River; no spur enters this property.
